original_title: How to recover lost Sprites in Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 3
summary_en: Did you lose precious Sprites in Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 3? Don't despair, as a recovery system is in place for your collected companions. Learn how to get them back and what resources you'll need.
ai_analysis: This season's Sprite mechanic adds a layer of persistent collection and risk-reward to Fortnite's battle royale, encouraging strategic play beyond just survival.

en.title: Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 3: How to Reclaim Your Lost Sprites
en.summary: Did you lose precious Sprites in Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 3? Don't despair, as a recovery system is in place for your collected companions. Learn how to get them back and what resources you'll need.
en.body:
Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 3 has introduced a fascinating new collectible: Sprites. These valuable companions can be lost if you're eliminated during a match, whether they're equipped or in your inventory. Fortunately, Epic Games has implemented a system allowing players to recover most lost Sprites, provided they've been successfully extracted and added to your collection.

The key to recovering a lost Sprite lies in its status within your collection. If a Sprite has been successfully extracted after being found, it remains permanently cataloged. This means even if you fall in battle with it equipped or in your inventory, you haven't truly lost it forever. The process to get it back into your active loadout is straightforward, but it comes with a cost.

## Retrieving Your Companion Collection

When a Sprite is lost due to elimination, it will still be present in your collection screen. To bring it back into your active loadout for a new round, you'll need a specific resource: **Sprite Dust**. This valuable currency is earned through successful Sprite extractions. The amount of Sprite Dust you receive varies depending on the rarity of the Sprite you extract.

Repurchasing a Sprite using Sprite Dust will restore it to your loadout, and importantly, it will retain its previous **Mastery Rank**. However, it will reset to Level 1. Leveling up Sprites is a core part of their progression, and thankfully, this process is designed to be engaging for active players.

## The Cost of Bringing Back Your Sprites

The price to respawn a lost Sprite is directly tied to its rarity, meaning rarer Sprites demand a higher Sprite Dust cost. Here's a breakdown of the Sprite Dust required for each tier:

- Rare: 100 Sprite Dust
- Epic: 3000 Sprite Dust
- Special Rare: 4000 Sprite Dust
- Legendary: 5000 Sprite Dust
- Special Epic: 6000 Sprite Dust
- Special Legendary: 10,000 Sprite Dust
- Special Mythic: 12,000 Sprite Dust

It's crucial to understand that if you lose a Sprite *before* successfully extracting it, there is no recovery method. In such cases, your only recourse is to find that specific Sprite again on the island and complete its extraction process. This emphasizes the importance of securing your finds as soon as possible.

## What's Next

As the season progresses, players will undoubtedly be hunting for new Sprites and aiming to complete their collections. Keep an eye out for new extraction opportunities and manage your Sprite Dust wisely to ensure your favorite companions are always ready for battle.

tr.title: Fortnite Bölüm 7 Sezon 3: Kayıp Sprite'lerinizi Geri Alma Rehberi
tr.summary: Fortnite Bölüm 7 Sezon 3'te değerli Sprite'lerinizi kaybettiyseniz endişelenmeyin. Epic Games, bu situation için bir kurtarma sistemi geliştirdi. Bu sistem, kayıp Sprite'lerinizi geri almanızı sağlıyor. Ancak bunun için bazı kaynaklara ihtiyacınız olacak.
tr.body:
Fortnite Bölüm 7 Sezon 3, yeni bir koleksiyon öğesi olan Sprite'leri tanıttı. Bu değerli arkadaşlar, bir maç sırasında elenirseniz, ekipmanınızda veya envanterinizde olsun, kaybedilebilir. Neyse ki Epic Games, çoğu kayıp Sprite'i kurtarma sistemi geliştirdi. Bu sistem, Sprite'lerinizi geri almanızı sağlıyor.

## Kayıp Sprite'lerinizi Geri Alma

Bir Sprite'i kaybettiğinizde, koleksiyon ekranınızda hala görünür. Ancak onu aktif yüklemeye geri getirmek için **Sprite Tozu** adlı bir kaynağa ihtiyacınız olacak. Bu değerli para, başarılı Sprite çıkarmaları sayesinde kazanılabiliyor. Alacağınız Sprite Tozu miktarı, çıkardığınız Sprite'in nadirliğine bağlı olarak değişiyor.

Bir Sprite'i Sprite Tozu kullanarak geri satın alırsanız, önceki **Ustalık Derecesi**'ni korur ancak 1. Seviyeye sıfırlanır. Sprite'leri seviye atlatmak, onların ilerlemesinin önemli bir parçasıdır ve bu süreç, aktif oyuncular için tasarlanmıştır.

## Kayıp Sprite'lerinizi Geri Getirme Maliyeti

Kayıp bir Sprite'i geri getirmek için gereken maliyet, doğrudan onun nadirliğine bağlıdır. Daha nadir Sprite'ler, daha yüksek Sprite Tozu maliyeti talep eder. İşte her seviye için gereken Sprite Tozu miktarı:

- Nadir: 100 Sprite Tozu
- Efsanevi: 3000 Sprite Tozu
- Özel Nadir: 4000 Sprite Tozu
- Efsane: 5000 Sprite Tozu
- Özel Efsanevi: 6000 Sprite Tozu
- Özel Mitik: 12.000 Sprite Tozu

Önemli bir nokta, bir Sprite'i çıkarma işlemini tamamlamadan önce kaybederseniz, onu geri alma yöntemi yoktur. Böyle durumlarda, tek çözüm, o specific Sprite'i adada tekrar bulmak ve çıkarma işlemini tamamlamaktır. Bu, bulduklarınızı mümkün olduğunca çabuk güvence altına almanın önemini vurgulamaktadır.

## Sonraki Adımlar

Sezon ilerledikçe, oyuncular yeni Sprite'ler avlayacak ve koleksiyonlarını tamamlamaya çalışacaklardır. Yeni çıkarma fırsatlarına dikkat edin ve Sprite Tozu'nuzu akıllıca yöneterek favori arkadaşlarınızın her zaman savaş için hazır olmasını sağlayın.

es.title: Capítulo 7 Temporada 3 de Fortnite: Cómo Recuperar Tus Sprites Perdidos
es.summary: ¿Perdiste Sprites valiosos en el Capítulo 7 Temporada 3 de Fortnite? No te desanimes, ya que hay un sistema de recuperación para tus compañeros recogidos. Aprende a recuperarlos y qué recursos necesitarás. Epic Games ha implementado un sistema que te permite recuperar la mayoría de los Sprites perdidos, siempre y cuando hayan sido extraídos y agregados con éxito a tu colección.
es.body:
Fortnite Capítulo 7 Temporada 3 ha introducido un nuevo objeto coleccionable fascinante: los Sprites. Estos valiosos compañeros pueden perderse si eres eliminado durante una partida, ya sea que estén equipados o en tu inventario. Afortunadamente, Epic Games ha implementado un sistema que permite a los jugadores recuperar la mayoría de los Sprites perdidos, siempre y cuando hayan sido extraídos y agregados con éxito a tu colección.

## Recuperando Tu Colección de Compañeros

La clave para recuperar un Sprite perdido radica en su estado dentro de tu colección. Si un Sprite ha sido extraído con éxito después de ser encontrado, permanece catalogado de forma permanente. Esto significa que incluso si caes en combate con él equipado o en tu inventario, no lo has perdido para siempre. El proceso para recuperarlo en tu carga activa es sencillo, pero conlleva un costo.

Cuando un Sprite se pierde debido a la eliminación, aún estará presente en la pantalla de tu colección. Para devolverlo a tu carga activa para una nueva ronda, necesitarás un recurso específico: **Polvo de Sprite**. Esta valiosa moneda se gana a través de extracciones de Sprites exitosas. La cantidad de Polvo de Sprite que recibes varía según la rareza del Sprite que extraes.

## El Costo de Recuperar Tus Sprites

El precio para revivir un Sprite perdido está directamente relacionado con su rareza, lo que significa que los Sprites más raros requieren un costo de Polvo de Sprite más alto. A continuación, se muestra el desglose del Polvo de Sprite necesario para cada nivel:

- Raro: 100 Polvo de Sprite
- Épico: 3000 Polvo de Sprite
- Raro Especial: 4000 Polvo de Sprite
- Legendario: 5000 Polvo de Sprite
- Épico Especial: 6000 Polvo de Sprite
- Legendario Especial: 10,000 Polvo de Sprite
- Mítico Especial: 12,000 Polvo de Sprite

Es crucial entender que si pierdes un Sprite *antes* de extraerlo con éxito, no hay método de recuperación. En tales casos, tu única opción es encontrar ese Sprite específico nuevamente en la isla y completar su proceso de extracción. Esto enfatiza la importancia de asegurar tus hallazgos lo antes posible.

## Próximos Pasos

A medida que avance la temporada, los jugadores sin duda estarán buscando nuevos Sprites y tratando de completar sus colecciones. Mantén un ojo atento a nuevas oportunidades de extracción y administra tu Polvo de Sprite con sabiduría para asegurarte de que tus compañeros favoritos estén siempre listos para la batalla.

content_raw: Sprites are immensely valuable in Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 3, and there’s a wonderful chance to recover the lost ones. You can lose a Sprite if you die while having them equipped on you. The same also applies for all Sprites that are in your inventory in the dying moments. Let’s figure out how you can recover them along with the required resources. How to get back your lost Sprites in Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 3 You can recover any Sprite that’s already added to your collection. When you lose a Sprite due to death, it will remain in your collection. This is why it’s so important to extract a new Sprite when you find one. A successful extraction will add it to your collection. Screenshot by Destructoid If you lose a new Sprite before you can extract it, there’s no way of recovery. The only alternative in that case is to find it once again and complete its extraction. If you lose a Sprite and it’s there in your collection, you can equip it before a fresh round. Screenshot by Destructoid All you need is to ensure that you have sufficient Sprite Dust. You get this resource every time you complete a successful extraction. The amount of Sprite Dust you receive depends on which Sprite is being extracted. Similarly, the cost of respawning a Sprite also varies based on its rarity. Here’s how much every Sprite costs to respawn in Chapter 7 Season 3. Rare: 100 Sprite Dust Epic: 3000 Sprite Dust Special Rare: 4000 Sprite Dust Legendary: 5000 Sprite Dust Special Epic: 6000 Sprite Dust Special Legendary: 10,000 Sprite Dust Special Mythic: 12,000 Sprite Dust When you repurchase a Sprite, it will retain its previous Mastery Rank. However, it will again begin from Level 1. However, leveling any Sprite up is easy as long as you’re actively getting involved in kills and opening chests on the maps. If your collection is still limited, you can always trade with other players for variants .
